test_title: PYST 7: SSC JE CE- General Intelligence (Held On 11 Oct 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Eight people are sitting in two parallel rows containing four people each in such a way that there is equal distance between adjacent persons.

In the first row, A, B, C and D are seated and all of them are facing the south.

In the second row, W, X, Y and Z are seated and all of them are facing the north.

Thus, each person faces another person from the other row.

The person facing Z is sitting third to the left of A. W is sitting second to the left of Z. C is the only neighbour of B who sits at extreme end. D is facing the one who is the immediate neighbour of Y and X.

Who amongst the following faces Z?
solution:
The sitting arrangement as per the given information:

1. W is sitting second to the left of Z.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a91f47f849961ec2d46a1d228dbf0cae0de7b156c4f9460208072a63cedc62a8.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/17cd3a7adda40242f925bc387bb43e617fb11a474da1fc051f4e5e12a0b0e0e5.png] 

2. The person facing Z is sitting third to the left of A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/30839447a48b09d51594167de8f3c67d315819b5138bad1e62a7fc068a61a0be.png] 

3.. C is the only neighbour of B who sits at extreme end

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a21e1d928302648a12aae3bcb98431e979a506b93cc840496632a92364657f67.png] 

4. D is facing the one who is the immediate neighbour of Y and X.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f7ba8c4d03da1143f364d8635bb0a2c5e493666da7753f35dedf8cf9d49df2b4.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cad94f86c6ac4efc7f1fe156c196c7d42c825010d6181cf1a23170794cafd8e1.png] 

Here, in both cases **'B'** is opposite to 'Z'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (1)".
